newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-BATISTUTA MISSES AS FIORENTINA DRAW WITH LAZIO.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BATISTUTA MISSES AS FIORENTINA DRAW WITH LAZIO.

text.p: Argentine striker Gabriel Batistuta missed a penalty for Fiorentina while Lazio goalkeeper Luca Marchegiani made several dramatic saves on Saturday in a 0-0 serie A draw between the two teams.
The topsy-turvy match saw rapid counter-attacks for much of the first half but none of the handful of top international strikers on the pitch could put the ball in the net.

Brazilian-born Luis Oliveira, who plays for Belgium, proved fresher than tired team mate Batistuta, still recovering from Argentina's World Cup victory over Venezuela this week, but wasted several chances in front of Marchigiani.

But Lazio's Giuseppe Signori and Pierluigi Casiraghi, who was repeatedly wide of the mark for Italy against Georgia in midweek, blew just as many opportunities in front of fellow international goalkeeper Francesco Toldo.
Batitusta, whose form has been surprisingly lacklustre so far this season, kicked a 34th minute penalty high after his cross was handled by defender Giuseppe Favalli.
Oliveira had his chance 10 minutes after the interval: One on one with Marchegiani, he tried to dummy the 'keeper who dived and managed to block the shot.
It was the last real opportunity of the match.
